name: Apollonian
author: E. T. Carter
description: A ball of Apollonian packing on a slim tripod on a dark studio floor: spheres in the gaps between spheres, down past what the eye can see, cut to a sphere. Shallow spheres are pale and lit, deep ones dark and coloured, and a light from inside breathes out through the gaps; slowly the fold drifts and the whole packing re-tiles into larger spheres and back.

sculpture.label: Spheres packed into the gaps between spheres, down past what the eye can see, cut to a ball. A light breathes out from inside, and slowly the packing re-tiles.

params.label: Turn
params.effect: Turntable speed: 1 is one turn a minute, 0 holds it still while its own motion goes on.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: How far the fold drifts, re-tiling the packing into larger and finer spheres; 0 holds one packing.

params.effect: How far the pointer orbits the camera round the piece; 0 ignores the mouse.
